instruction.name: x86settm
instruction.description: Set the x87 translation mode, enabling TOP-based remapping of the FPRs.

notes: LBT set of the translation-mode bit.

throughput.name: 16 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm
throughput.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 50 --unroll2 200 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r12, 5' --asm 'x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm; x86settm; x86clrtm'
throughput.notes: The translation-mode bit breaks the epilogue of the surrounding function, so it is measured as an alternating pair with x86clrtm and the pair is halved.
